description: Small envelope generator that sends a linear ramp from 0V to 10V over a set time when it is triggered, with a gate, an end-of-cycle pulse and a finished flag beside it

params.text: Sets the length of the ramp, from 1ms to 10 seconds with the switch at LOG and from 0 to 10 seconds with it at LIN, and the figure in seconds is printed on the display
Sets how much a volt at the CV input changes the ramp, clockwise from the centre lengthening it and counter-clockwise shortening it, by as much as 10 seconds per 10V at either end
Chooses how the duration knob is read: LIN spreads 0 to 10 seconds evenly across its travel, LOG spreads 1ms to 10 seconds across it so that the short times get most of the turn

inputs.text: A rising edge starts the ramp from 0V, restarting it if one is already running; it reads high above 2V
Lengthens or shortens the ramp by the amount set by the CV AMT knob, with the total held between 0 and 10 seconds
A rising edge stops the ramp at once and drops it to its finished value; it reads high above 2V

outputs.text: The ramp itself, climbing evenly from 0V to 10V over the set time and resting at 0V or 10V as the menu sets
Carries 10V from the start of the ramp until it finishes, and 0V at all other times
Carries a 1ms pulse of 10V at the moment the ramp finishes
Carries 10V whenever no ramp is running and 0V while one is, which is the GATE output turned upside down

notes: the module makes nothing until a trigger arrives at TRG IN; the duration knob alone starts nothing
a polyphonic cable in TRG IN or CV makes every output polyphonic with that many ramps; a monophonic cable in TRG IN, CV or STOP acts on all of the channels at once
menu: Ramp value when finished: 0V, 10V — chooses what the RAMP output holds once the ramp has ended, which at 10V prevents a click when a sample is being played from an Array
Send EOC on STOP — sends the EOC pulse when a trigger at STOP cuts the ramp short, as well as when the ramp reaches its end
Update duration only on trigger — freezes the duration at the value it had when the last trigger arrived, instead of following the knob and CV while the ramp runs

inputs.0:
high above 2V · stepped · polyphonic

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
high above 2V · stepped · polyphonic

a negative voltage does nothing here.
